cues.en: I'm now going to break the video to give you an opportunity to get up and stretch your legs and splash water on your face, and so on.
cues.zh: 我現在要把影片切開，讓你有機會起身、伸展腿，或洗把臉等等。

cues.en: When you're ready, when you're feeling refreshed, come back to the next video where we will complete the code challenge.
cues.zh: 準備好、精神恢復之後，再回來看下一支影片，完成這次程式挑戰。
